complete_examples.text: Subsequently, the aforementioned model is applied to the dynamic analysis of the TTTS system to investigate the ground vibration distribution induced by the train, and to examine the effects of the TTTS system parameters on the ground vibration in terms of time–frequency domain vibration and vibration level.

At this point, the maximum Z-vibration level are 59.5 dB, 57.4 dB and 53.8 dB, respectively, while the corresponding maximum acceleration values are 11.07 mm/s2, 8.49 mm/s2 and 4.78 mm/s2, respectively.
